attributes.mechanism: NAMED, single instruction: MWCC schedules the ADDR16_LO `addi` that materializes sSpeechNameBuf into the pre-prologue shadow slots, where it must target scratch r0 because the callee-saved home r30 cannot be written before `stmw r30,8(r1)` saves it; the value is then homed with `mr r30,r0` after the prologue. The target defers the identical addi past the stmw and writes r30 directly, needing no copy. Register allocation, save set, and frame size are otherwise identical -- r30=buf, r31=ch in both streams. r0 as the addi destination is the diagnostic tell.
